items.claim: Canceled color or size drag stays applied in the Theme panel
items.note: `useThemeEdit` gains `cancel()`, wired to the color fields and the font Size field. It drops the pending frame, rewinds history to before the gesture's first write, drops the redo entry and seals.

items.claim: Renaming a role to its own name forks the theme and records an undo entry
Style panel's Text color reads the header row
items.note: diagram gains `diagramColorOf` and `diagramFontSizeOf`. They read through the same text nodes `setDiagramColor` and `setDiagramFontSize` write, and `setDiagramColor` now shares that filter. Changeset `diagram-color-of` (minor, api).

items.claim: Connector label found by a hand-built id
items.note: The same reader finds labels by `dependsOn`; a test covers a label stored under another id.

items.claim: Style panel shows no color for translucent or non-hex colors
items.note: It now accepts any color `tryParseColor` reads, and the color fields take `alpha`, so a pick no longer drops opacity.

items.claim: A theme change re-lays out plots without the caller's `measure`
items.note: `applyChartTheme` passes `plotMeasureOf(opts.measure)` to `replacePlotData`, and diagram-formats now exports `plotMeasureOf`. Changeset `diagram-formats-plot-measure-of` (minor, api). In practice `rendererMeasure` and plot's `textMeasure` give the same result for plain plot text. So this fixes a dropped option and a measure that could drift, more than a layout shift you would see today.
